items.title: Work with Codex from anywhere
items.summary: OpenAI put Codex into the ChatGPT mobile app preview so developers can follow, steer, approve, and continue coding-agent work from a phone.
signals: mobile review and approval loops matter
local credentials stay on the developer machine

items.title: Anthropic forms $200 million partnership with the Gates Foundation
items.summary: Anthropic and the Gates Foundation announced funding, Claude credits, technical support, datasets, and benchmarks for global health, education, economic mobility, and agriculture programs.
signals: frontier AI is moving into public-good deployments
domain benchmarks and datasets are part of responsible rollout
agriculture-specific improvements are planned as public goods

items.title: Introducing Claude for Small Business
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude for Small Business with connectors and ready-to-run workflows across tools like QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365.
signals: AI value is shifting from chat to approved workflows
small-business workflows need trust and permissions
skills and connectors package repeated work

items.title: A smarter, more proactive Android with Gemini Intelligence
items.summary: Google announced Gemini Intelligence for Android, including app automation, smarter Chrome browsing, intelligent form filling, custom widgets, and speech-to-polished-text features.
signals: AI is becoming an operating-system layer
multistep mobile task automation is moving mainstream
user control and opt-in context matter

items.title: Advancing voice intelligence with new models in the API
items.summary: OpenAI introduced realtime voice, translation, and transcription models for voice agents that reason, use tools, translate live, and transcribe low-latency speech.
signals: voice agents are becoming workflow interfaces
live translation and transcription are developer primitives
